title: General Conditions of the Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan: Follow-On Plans, Purchase Bars and Presentation
content:
These general conditions apply to every Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan.

**1. Follow-on plans.** A follow-on plan may be bought where the plan allows follow-on plans, no earlier than the plan's renewal window — that number of calendar days — before the current term end, and it locks the rent in effect on its own start date.

**2. Receipts and statements.** Receipts are sent by the plan's receipt delivery method and statements at the plan's statement frequency, showing savings on the plan's savings display basis under the plan's short name.

**3. Rounding.** Plan amounts follow the plan's rounding rule.

**4. Cancellation after the free window.** A cancellation after the free-cancellation window is treated on the plan's basis for such cancellations.

**5. Purchase bars.** A plan cannot be bought for an agreement that is delinquent or in a lien stage, that owes a balance, or that has a move-out notice.

**6. Late fees and the move-in discount.** Late fees cannot arise on prepaid rent, and stacking with the move-in discount is never allowed.

**7. Ledger.** Applications appear on the agreement ledger under the plan's application label.

The renewal window, receipt delivery method, statement frequency, savings display basis, short name, rounding rule, treatment of a late cancellation and application label are set for each plan.

## Condition 1 at its boundary (hypothetical dates)

A current term ends on 30 June, and the plan's renewal window is 60 calendar days.

| Purchase date of the follow-on plan | Calendar days before the term end | Within condition 1 |
|---|---|---|
| 30 April | 61 | No — earlier than the window allows |
| 1 May | 60 | Yes — not earlier than 60 days before |
| 20 June | 10 | Yes |

The follow-on plan locks the rent in effect on its own start date; if the agreement's rent has changed by that date, the follow-on plan locks the changed rent, not the rent locked by the current plan.

## Condition 5 as a check (hypothetical agreements)

| Agreement at the time of purchase | Plan may be bought under condition 5 |
|---|---|
| Delinquent | No |
| In a lien stage | No |
| Owes a balance | No |
| Has a move-out notice | No |
| None of the above | Condition 5 does not bar it |

## Condition 6 restated

During the term no late fee arises on the rent the plan has prepaid. A move-in discount on the agreement never combines with a plan.
